TC-16/S26.title: Hospital next-day activity before 18 h: yesterday's typed notes are neither merged into today's row nor lost
TC-16/S26.detail: New local spec: day-1 note seeded with encounterEditedAt = now−16 h; on the Encounter tab the day-1 note is still in the box (cp1 pass); the day-2 line typed after it, autosaved with no save tap; the edit clock then backdated to now−19 h and the list opened (the lifecycle runs). The day-1 note is never lost and both left the working box (pass), but they are archived together in one row, 'Oct 13 · Encounter notes' (1 entry: day-1 then day-2 text), dated by the last edit: cp3/cp4 fail. The matrix reports a merged row as a Fail with Q13 attached until Q13 is answered (D11).
TC-16/S26.productIssue: Any next-day edit restarts the Hospital 18 h encounter clock, so typed notes left in the box from day 1 are archived with the day-2 text in one row dated by the day-2 edit. Whether one merged row is acceptable is Q13 (D11).
